blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Carlos Yulo was dethroned in the vault final of the 2026 Artistic Gymnastics World Championships on Sunday in Rotterdam, Netherlands. Yulo placed seventh with a final mark of 13.833. He couldn’t land gracefully on his first vault with 0.300 deduction and scored 13.333 on a 5.600 difficulty. The two-time Olympic gold medalist recovered in his second vault with 14.433 points on a 5.200 difficulty only to miss the podium.
